name: clueless
description: Responsibility-flip mode for when the user cannot review the output: irreversible steps first, one verification step, every default named, at most three questions only the user can answer.

interface.shortDescription: Tell the agent you know nothing. It becomes the only reviewer in the room.
interface.longDescription: When the user says they cannot review the output, the agent acts as the only reviewer: it puts irreversible steps first, gives one verification step, names every default it chose with the alternative, and ends with at most three questions only the user can answer, each pre-filled with the assumption. Includes a one-shot /clueless-blindspots review.
defaultPrompt: I know nothing about this, set it up properly for me
What am I not seeing in this plan?
